title: The Scream
description: One of the most iconic images in art history, depicting an agonized figure against a tumultuous orange sky

title: Madonna
description: A sensual and spiritual representation of a woman, blending eroticism with religious imagery

title: The Sick Child
description: A deeply personal work depicting the death of his sister Sophie from tuberculosis

title: Anxiety
description: Features the same setting as The Scream but with a group of people walking towards the viewer

title: The Dance of Life
description: Depicts the three stages of woman represented through dance and color symbolism

title: Vampire
description: A controversial work showing a woman with red hair embracing a man, interpreted as both tender and sinister

title: Melancholy
description: Shows a solitary figure in the foreground with a couple in the background by the sea

title: The Voice
description: A young woman in white standing among vertical tree trunks at twilight

title: Puberty
description: A nude young girl sitting on a bed with her arms crossed, with a dark shadow behind her

title: Death in the Sickroom
description: A family gathered in grief, showing the psychological impact of loss

title: The Kiss
description: Two figures melting together in an intimate embrace, their faces merged into one

title: Ashes
description: A man and woman after a failed relationship, with symbolic elements of death and rebirth

title: Jealousy
description: Features a man's face in the foreground with a couple in the background, exploring themes of desire and betrayal

title: The Sun
description: A massive radiant sun over a fjord landscape, one of his most optimistic works

title: Girls on the Pier
description: Young women on a wooden pier, a recurring motif in Munch's work representing youth and transition

title: Self-Portrait with Cigarette
description: A haunting self-portrait showing the artist in a haze of cigarette smoke

title: The Storm
description: Figures struggling against wind near white houses, expressing emotional turbulence

title: Starry Night
description: A night scene with a white fence and shadowy figures, predating van Gogh's famous work

title: Summer Night
description: A serene landscape with a house by the water during the Nordic summer twilight

title: Workers Returning Home
description: A social realist work depicting laborers at the end of their workday
